facts.text: The Nebraska State College Tuition Guarantee covers tuition costs up to 18 credits per semester for first-time freshmen or incoming transfer students who are Pell Grant-eligible or whose annual family adjusted gross income on the FAFSA is $70,000 or less.

sources.title: Our Tuition Guarantee – Wayne State College Nebraska
sources.quote: The Nebraska State College Tuition Guarantee provides financial assistance for first-time freshmen or incoming transfer students who are Pell Grant-eligible or whose annual family adjusted gross income as reported on the FAFSA is $70,000 or less

sources.title: Our Tuition Guarantee – Wayne State College Nebraska
sources.quote: The Tuition Guarantee covers your cost of tuition, up to 18 credits per semester.

facts.text: Through the Rural Health Opportunities Program (RHOP), students recruited from rural Nebraska receive free tuition at WSC and guaranteed admission to the University of Nebraska Medical Center (UNMC).

sources.title: Rural Health Opportunities Program (RHOP) - Wayne State College Nebraska
sources.quote: RHOP recruits students from rural Nebraska to become health care professionals. RHOP students receive free tuition at WSC and guaranteed admission to UNMC.
